text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a fan meet and greet in the
shopping
district today, which Special
Week will be
participating in. I'm there
waiting for her when...

La la laaa! Badum deedum! ♪ La dee
dah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Have no fear, for Special
Week is
here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Just gettin' ready to
rock-'n'-rule as the
Ruler of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I happened to overhear yesterday that
an actor in
Opera O's play couldn't make
it, and that there
was an opening
available!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I learned it was for the role of a
feudal
ruler, I thought of this signature
racewear and
realized that it was surely
fate!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And before I knew it, I had volunteered
to fill in
for the role!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, the show's about to start, so
you should
come watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is as confident as ever,
but I'm
really worried. She was chosen
for the role only
yesterday. Does she
even know her lines?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine! Opera O will handle the
important
dialogue, and all I have to do
is improvise lines
that sound lordly!
choice_data_list: 台本とか大丈夫なのか？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I'd better get ready! See you
later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look on as she runs toward the stage
that has
been built in the shopping
district. I guess the
least I can do is
watch her performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Father, isn't there anything we can
do to
make you accept our
engagement?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... Absolutely not! I refuse! And I'll
never
change my mind on the matter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But why?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Because, uh, as the ruler... I don't
really
want to!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my lord! Is your refusal due to my
lowly
status? Am I not fit to number
among your
prestigious family?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-exactly! Our family's incredible! After
all, I can,
uh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I can eat fifty shrimp tempura bowls, fifty bowls of ramen, fifty pieces of fried chicken, and finish it off with ten actual buckets of pudding!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-well?! Are you able to do the same?
If not,
then I won't ever acknowledge
you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, woe upon me! I'm incapable of
doing such!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Since things have come to this...

Princess!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Won't you flee with me to a far-flung
country?
Take my hand, that we may
throw ourselves upon
the tempestuous
sea of fate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Father, isn't there anything we can
do to
make you accept our
engagement?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! L-like I said, it's because Oper—I
mean, this
individual isn't able to eat
enough shrimp
tempura bowls!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what genre this play was
supposed
to be, but it's a full-on
comedy now. The show
trips along the
same way until the curtains fall.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! I was terrible out there! I'm so
sorry, Opera
O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! What are you talking about?
Just listen
to that crowd!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Spe! You were so funny!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I brought you something to snack on!
You must
be hungry after that
performance, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! Is that yakisoba and
takoyaki?! You
brought so much!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! That just proves how
delighted the
audience was with your
performance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And what courage! You didn't hesitate
to
volunteer as a replacement actor
when you heard
of our plight!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Though you were always on the cusp of
being
overtaken by distress, you never
broke character
as a ruler and carried on
nobly!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You have the makings of a star actor...
You truly
embody the role of a ruler!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Me? A good ruler?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! But of course! There's
nothing to
fear with me around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems things didn't pan out the way
she
expected, but Special Week was
able to play a
fantastic(?) ruler, so all's
well that ends well.
